csat.note: CSAT is a 1-5 score distribution plus the sealed reason enum (too long / didn't understand me / felt rushed / helpful / felt heard). Every figure names its cohort and window and no target is rendered beside it (invariant 20): csat.score's catalogue target (>= 4.3) is metadata, not a verdict on a reading. csat.score/csat.reason are live, but the console reads a scrape at serve time; with no response recorded the cohort is below the k >= 10 floor, so only the count survives (invariant 17; files/06 §8).

nps.note: NPS on the standard 0-10 scale, the promoter/passive/detractor split that produced it shown as counts. Below the k >= 10 floor nothing but the count survives (files/08 §0c F9); no response has been recorded, so the cohort is empty (invariant 17).

pulse.note: Quarterly clinician pulse, 1-5. Clinicians appear as counts only — a clinician_ref never reaches an aggregate (invariant 6). Below the k >= 10 floor only the count survives; no response has been recorded (invariant 17).

dimensions.reason: the experience aggregates carry no branch dimension; slicing an operational aggregate by branch × narrow window × small clinic is files/08 §0c F9's re-identification case, and adding one is a data-inventory decision under invariant 18 (stop-and-ask: Owner + compliance_officer; open in docs/evidence/INT-241.md, no HUMAN_BLOCKERS.md row minted)
csat.v1 / nps.v1 / clinician_pulse.v1 carry no voice-profile field; adding one is a data-inventory decision under invariant 18

the experience aggregates carry no clinic dimension; slicing an operational aggregate by branch × narrow window × small clinic is files/08 §0c F9's re-identification case, and adding one is a data-inventory decision under invariant 18 (stop-and-ask: Owner + compliance_officer; open in docs/evidence/INT-241.md, no HUMAN_BLOCKERS.md row minted)

filters.note: The acceptance asks to filter by branch / profile / clinic. The mechanism ships and fails closed: the underlying events carry none of these dimensions today, tenant scope is a token claim rather than a query parameter (files/08 §8 rule (a), the F9 IDOR), and the window is required with no default (invariant 20).

rows: both: the Talker holds the turn in memory and writes no lifecycle row, and sessions.started_at has no writer outside the test harness
the start: notes.created_at exists, but nothing transitions a session to COMPLETED, so sessions.completed_at is never written

the end: INT-150 landed the redemption route, and every open is written to the hash-chained audit log — which is EVIDENCE, not an analytics source, and is never mined for aggregates. No share-access row and no first_opened_at column exist. INT-307 built the unlabelled path this series needed, so the writer is no longer what is missing: landing a first-open instant on the share is, and no issue claims it
both: files/08 §4 G scopes this to connector tenants and packages/connectors does not exist (blocked by INT-163)

sds01_export.note: The SDS-01 style aggregate export for a hospital tenant (files/01 §4; files/08 §3). Tenant-scoped from the token, aggregate only: no clinic, branch, clinician or patient column (files/08 §0c F9; INT-241 §4). Rows are produced by intake_metrics.sds01.sds01_table over the real wait sources for the recorded window — records_processing reads no_observations (observable, empty) and the other four source_unavailable (an instant this repo does not yet record), so nothing is fabricated (invariant 17). Every cell is neutralised against spreadsheet-formula injection (invariant 47).
